name: wa-broadcaster
description: Link WhatsApp accounts by QR code and send one message to many contacts, one at a time. Django + Celery backend, React frontend.

scripts.docker:up: cd ../.. && docker compose up -d --build wa wa-backend wa-worker wa-beat wa-gateway
scripts.docker:down: cd ../.. && docker compose stop wa wa-backend wa-worker wa-beat wa-gateway
scripts.docker:logs: cd ../.. && docker compose logs -f --tail=100 wa wa-backend wa-worker wa-beat wa-gateway
